slot.intent: The memo the night before the raid told staff to shred everything that night.

concept: The memo's words type out one at a time in mono behind a steady caret; its kicker shrinks to a header as the quote is due, and the red selection sweeps the order as its last word is typed.
storyboard: 0.0 s, on "The": the kicker starts as the headline, large tracked capitals at the block's left edge, grey settling to off white
1.0 s, on "memo": the second kicker word settles beside it
2.0 s, on "said:": the kicker completes as THE MEMO SAID, settled by 2.25 s
2.3 s: the kicker glides upward into a small header above the quote and steps back to mid grey, one smooth move landing at 2.95 s
3.0 s, on "shred": as the header lands, the quote starts in large JetBrains Mono behind a hanging opening quote, the word typed whole
3.0 s: the word settles from grey to off white and a steady off-white caret appears after it
4.0 s, on "everything": the next word is typed in and the caret moves on after it
5.0 s, on "tonight.": the last word is typed with the closing quote and, in the caret's place, a flat red selection starts across the phrase
5.0 s to 5.46 s: the selection runs across everything tonight in one stroke, off the mark at once and slowing into the last word
5.46 s: full hold on the header, the quote and its selection to the end; the camera never moves

leansOn.title: Chapter title (this channel's approved version)
leansOn.why: The highlight lands with the last word in one motion, which the owner asked for there.
